Check that MS1Match and a grouping tool used the same feature table

Source: R/grouping_evaluation_generic.R
check_feature_match.Rd

A yes/no check. The answer is TRUE only if

  1. every MS1Match reference feature exists in feature_table with the same m/z, and

  2. every feature id shared by the grouping table and feature_table has the same m/z (and, where available, the same RT), and at least one id is shared.

Feature ids alone are not enough: separate xcms runs all name their features FT0001, FT0002, ...

One table may be a subset of the other, e.g. MS1Match run on an RT-truncated feature table and the grouping tool on the full one. Ids present in only one of them do not fail the check; they are counted and excluded by evaluate_grouping.

Usage

check_feature_match(
  anno_result,
  grouping,
  feature_table,
  mz_tol = 0.001,
  rt_tol = 1
)

Arguments

anno_result

Output of join_annotation_results().

grouping

Output of prepare_grouping_table or a converter; must contain mz.

feature_table

The feature table MS1Match was run on (e.g. out$ft for xcms, or read_mzmine_feature_table() for MZmine). Must contain feature_name and mzmed or mz.

mz_tol

Allowed m/z difference in Da, only to absorb rounding (e.g. RAMClustR's mzdec). Default 0.001.

rt_tol

Allowed RT difference in seconds. Default 1.

Value

Object of class feature_table_check: a list with same_feature_table (TRUE/FALSE), summary (counts) and mismatches (one row per offending feature and reason).
